responsibility: Provides the RTL machine-description support for the RISC-V scalar cryptography extensions. It introduces the UNSPEC codes and instruction patterns for Zbkb/Zbkc/Zbkx and the Zk* AES, SHA, SM3, and SM4 instruction families, selecting RV32 vs RV64 forms as needed and assigning them backend instruction types so generic builtin expansion and RTL generation can emit the target crypto opcodes directly.
